title: create ultimate+ by drkum
body:
# Create Ultimate+

Welcome to **Create Ultimate+**, created by **drkum**. This is a premium Minecraft 1.21.1 modpack designed for technical engineers, aviation enthusiasts, and military tacticians. It perfectly blends high-tech mechanical automation, real physics flight, and heavy artillery combat.

---

## Overview
This pack is built on NeoForge and features amazing integration between the Create ecosystem and advanced technology. Customize your world with extensive automation, build massive war machines, and dominate the skies with custom aircraft.

---

## Features
* **Aviation & Physics:** Build fully functional airplanes, airships, and helicopters using Create Aeronautics and Simulated.
* **Heavy Artillery:** Design massive automated cannons and aerial bombers using Create Big Cannons and The Air War.
* **Industry & Automation:** Expand your factory with deep automation, diesel power generation, and advanced fluid logistics.
* **Performance:** Fully optimized for high FPS and smooth gameplay using Sodium, Iris, ModernFix, and FerriteCore.

---

## Requirements
* **Minecraft Version:** 1.21.1
* **Mod Loader:** NeoForge
* **Allocated RAM:** 6 GB - 8 GB recommended for the best experience.

---

## Credits
Special thanks to Simibubi (Create), TeamSable (Aeronautics), Master_C_Block (Big Cannons), and all the amazing developers who made these incredible mods possible!
 US:NOTE: If your game crashes due to Petrol's Parts language issues, open your official Minecraft Launcher. Go to Installations, edit your profile, click More Options, and add this code to the very end of the JVM Arguments box:
-Duser.language=en -Duser.country=US
TR:NOT: Eğer oyunu başlatırken Petrol's Parts modu yüzünden çökme (crash) hatası alırsanız: Orijinal Minecraft Launcher'ı açın, Yüklemeler (Installations) sekmesine gelin, oynadığınız sürümün yanındaki üç noktaya basıp Düzenle (Edit) deyin. En alttaki Daha Fazla Seçenek (More Options) kısmına tıklayıp JVM Bağımsız Değişkenleri (JVM Arguments) yazan kutunun en sonuna bir boşluk bırakarak şu kodu yapıştırın:
-Duser.language=en -Duser.country=US
🌐 How to Play with Friends (Multiplayer)
Although the package is tagged as Singleplayer, you can easily play with your friends!

Thanks to the Essential Mod included in the pack, you don't need to rent a server or set up complicated server files. As long as your friend has the exact same version of this modpack installed, you can just add each other as friends in-game and invite them directly to your world!

Quick Steps:

Open your singleplayer world.

Press ESC and invite your friend via the Essential menu.

Enjoy building ultimate Create factories together!

🇹🇷
Paket 'Singleplayer' olarak etiketlenmiş olsa bile arkadaşlarınızla kolayca oynayabilirsiniz! Paketteki Essential Modu sayesinde sunucu kiralamanıza gerek yok. Arkadaşınızda da aynı sürüm yüklüyse, oyun içinden birbirinizi ekleyip dünyaya davet edebilirsiniz.
